name: pe64
refuses: image layout inconsistent — misaligned sections, out-of-range RVAs, caps widening (archive side)
doc: PE64 executable container — the emit chain's target dialect: program/link/symtab/assemble/pack produce image bytes through the same bounded-read/validate/refuse shape as every other layer.  An ISA+ABI+container triplet, no different in kind than .plex.
